summary: Iter23 retest (code review + web smoke) of iter22 HIGH bug fixes — ALL PASS. CODE REVIEW of /app/frontend/src/components/live-video.native.tsx: (a) host canvas uid === join uid: selfUid=1 for host (L38-40), joinChannel uses selfUid (L133), canvas uid=showUid=selfUid with sourceType VideoSourceCamera (L174, L184-187) — CORRECT. (b) audience canvas uses uid=remoteUid with sourceType VideoSourceRemote (L174, L186-187) — the iter22 HIGH bug is FIXED; per SDK getFuncName routing, VideoSourceRemote now correctly routes to setupRemoteVideo. (c) startPreview() return code checked: rc===0 -> setPreviewReady(true), else readable error 'Kamera gagal dibuka (kode X). Tutup aplikasi lain yang memakai kamera lalu coba lagi.' (L126-131); previewReady no longer set blindly — FIXED. (d) No regressions vs official Agora RN playbook: permissions check -> getLiveToken -> createAgoraRtcEngine -> initialize -> registerEventHandler (incl. onError/onTokenPrivilegeWillExpire) -> enableVideo -> startPreview (host only) -> joinChannel with LiveBroadcasting + Broadcaster/Audience + publish flags; full cleanup (stopPreview/leaveChannel/unregisterEventHandler/release); canShow gates audience on joined && remoteUid != null. app.json android.permissions CONFIRMED: includes BLUETOOTH_CONNECT alongside BLUETOOTH, CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO, MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE, READ_MEDIA_IMAGES. WEB SMOKE PASS: guest /live shows intact full-screen 'Belum ada siaran live' layout; admin login (admin/admin123) works; /live-host shows host fallback message 'Kamera siaran hanya aktif di aplikasi HP (APK)' with LIVE badge, viewer count, action overlays and chat bar — no black screen. Backend suites not re-run per request.
action_items: All iter22 action items resolved — safe to rebuild the APK. Native host preview + native audience rendering both follow the official Agora RN playbook now.

OPTIONAL (not a regression): if startPreview() returns non-zero, joinChannel still proceeds (host joins but publishes no video). Error is surfaced to the user, so acceptable; could gate join on rc===0 in a future polish pass.
